description: End-to-end bidding runtime timing, queue pressure, inbound marketplace events, OpenSea calls, and process resources. If every panel is empty, enable the bidding metrics endpoint, restart the bidding bot, and confirm the Prometheus target is healthy.

panels.description: A value of 1 identifies the current lifecycle state for each bidding bot and chain ID.
panels.title: Runtime State

panels.description: Elapsed milliseconds from process start until the bidding bot can process work. The value is the current process lifetime average.

targets.expr: sum by (worker, chain_id) (artgod_trading_bidding_runtime_time_to_ready_ms_sum{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"}) / clamp_min(sum by (worker, chain_id) (artgod_trading_bidding_runtime_time_to_ready_ms_count{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"}), 1)

panels.title: Time to Ready per Bot Start

panels.description: Current-process lifetime average milliseconds for each completed startup phase. Startup failures remain authoritative in structured logs because the metrics endpoint can close before Prometheus scrapes a failed phase.

targets.expr: sum by (worker, chain_id, phase, result) (artgod_trading_bidding_runtime_bootstrap_phase_duration_ms_sum{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"}) / clamp_min(sum by (worker, chain_id, phase, result) (artgod_trading_bidding_runtime_bootstrap_phase_duration_ms_count{worker=~"$worker",chain_id=~"$chain_id"}), 1)

panels.title: Bootstrap Phase Duration per Bot Start

panels.description: Compares 95th-percentile milliseconds at the main handoff points so the largest end-to-end bottleneck is visible first.
panels.title: Critical Path Latency p95

panels.description: Concurrent and queued work across the bidding pipeline. Sustained growth indicates work is arriving faster than it completes.
panels.title: Active Pressure

panels.description: Cumulative failures and rejected offer syncs for the current bidding bot process across commands, scans, refreshes, inbound normalization and dispatch, OpenSea, snapshots, and bid-book updates. Raw totals keep a first or singleton failure visible even when it happened before Prometheus obtained a baseline scrape.
panels.title: Process-Lifetime Failures

panels.description: Final offer-sync results and inbound refresh queue decisions per second. Offer syncs remain split into complete, partial, and error results; dropped, evicted, and coalesced refresh outcomes remain visible without identifying individual NFTs.
panels.title: Offer Sync Results and Queue Decisions

panels.description: Live configured job concurrency, command batch size, and pending-signal caps for the selected bot and chain ID.
panels.title: Configured Concurrent Jobs and Queue Caps

panels.description: Configured milliseconds between scans, command polls, marketplace offer syncs, and inbound-refresh passes.
panels.title: Configured Cadences

panels.description: Current number of configured bidding jobs by bounded target type; it never identifies an individual job or collection.
